news.title: Nvidia's new PC chips represent CEO Huang's bid to win at every layer of AI stack
news.detail: Nvidia's announced entry into the PC chip market sent shares of AMD, Intel and Qualcomm lower as Wall Street recognized the threat.

news.title: Alphabet plans to raise $80 billion from stock sales to fund AI build-out
news.detail: Alphabet said it plans to sell $80 billion in stock, including through a $10 billion investment by Berkshire Hathaway.

news.title: Microsoft and Google are late to AI coding, but 'absolutely critical' they compete for growth
news.detail: Coding tools are becoming an increasingly big target for Google and Microsoft as they try to catch up to Anthropic and OpenAI.

news.title: S&P 500 scales to fresh record high as Nvidia leads chips higher: Live updates
news.detail: All three major indexes notched new intraday and closing highs on Monday.

news.title: HPE surges 25% after blowout earnings, pacing for its best day ever
news.detail: Shares of Hewlett Packard Enterprise surged 27% Tuesday morning, pacing its biggest daily gain ever as the company posted its biggest earnings beat since 2018.

news.title: Quantum宣布1亿美元股权融资 清偿债务并加速AI存储业务增长
news.detail: 数据存储与管理解决方案提供商Quantum Corporation于6月1日宣布达成三项同步交易，旨在彻底清除债务、引入成长资本，并大幅优化资产负债表。

news.title: Marvell stock soars 20% as Nvidia's Huang says it could be the next trillion-dollar company
news.detail: Nvidia's CEO, Jensen Huang, hailed this chip designer as the next trillion-dollar firm, sending its shares up sharply in early market trading.

news.title: 英国央行行长贝利：并非所有人工智能相关股都会成为赢家
news.detail: 英国央行行长安德鲁·贝利警告称，许多受人工智能热潮推高的股票从长远来看最终不会成为赢家。 贝利周二在英国上议院经济事务委员会的听证会上发表了讲话。

news.title: Polymarket closes its first block trade as prediction markets push for Wall Street adoption
news.detail: Prediction market platforms have increasingly looked to institutional traders, not individual ones, as the next venue for growth.

news.title: 慧与财报大超预期暴涨25%，有望创下史上最佳单日表现
news.detail: 核心要点慧与（HPE）财报创下 2018 年以来最大业绩超预期幅度，股价大幅飙升；旗下服务器业务受 AI 需求拉动，二季度营收数据大幅击穿市场一致预期。
